lines: His father had rejected him. His people had tried to burn him. His king had become his enemy.
Only a few believed in him. Among them was his nephew, Lut.
So Ibrahim left the land of his birth, with nothing but his faith.
He said: "Indeed, I will go to my Lord. He will guide me."
He travelled for years, through deserts and foreign lands, calling people to Allah wherever he went.
And as he grew older, he made one more dua: "My Lord, grant me a child from among the righteous."
And Allah gave him good news: a forbearing boy.
